title: Minecraft Server Log

panels.description: 💬 chat · 📢 /say · ⌨️ admin and RCON commands · 💀 deaths · 🟢 joins · 🔴 leaves · 🏆 advancements · ⚙️ server start/stop. Commands typed by non-op players are not written to the server log, so they cannot appear here.
